text:
Jess (Sales): Heads-up — enterprise POC with Acme starts next week. They just sent a SIG/CAIQ and asked for our IR timeline + breach notification process. Anyone able to help answer by EOD? Also they have pricing Qs around POC infra. Quick doc: https://files.redwood/sales/poc/acme-questions-brief.pdf

Ashley (Security): I can take the SIG/CAIQ. When's their deadline?

Jess (Sales): EOD Friday. They want SOC2, SIG/CAIQ, and an explicit breach timeline for the contract.

Mike (Solutions): For POC pricing — we can offer a 4-week POC at 50% off on Dedicated reserved capacity for trials. Will confirm seat counts and burst policy. @Emma can you chime in on infra setup?

Emma (SE): Yep. I'll draft the POC SOW & pricing and drop it in the sales folder. Quick Q: do they require Private deployment or will VPC-hosted suffice?

Jess (Sales): They prefer VPC for data residency. Security team: can we support a VPC POC package for 4 weeks?

Ashley (Security): We support VPC POCs but need a minimal security review before spin-up. For the SIG/CAIQ answers: I'll mark "partial" for controls that are only available in Private/self-hosted and provide compensating controls. Expect a draft in ~24h.

Sam (Legal): For breach notification language — standard is: GDPR customers: notify within 72 hours of becoming aware. For US-only customers we often say "without unreasonable delay." If they're asking for a firm timeline, recommend 72 hours in the contract to be explicit.

Ashley (Security): Operationally our playbook is: triage within 1h, contain ASAP (goal within 8–24h), and customer notification <=72h after we confirm a security incident affecting customer data. Excerpt below:

```
IR timeline (summary):
- Detect -> 0-1h (acknowledge)
- Triage -> 0-4h (scope)
- Contain -> 4-24h (mitigate)
- Customer notification -> <=72h (unless law requires sooner)
- Remediation & follow-up -> ongoing (post-mortem within 14 days)
Contact: security@redwood.ai, ir-oncall@redwood.ai
```

Jess (Sales): Perfect — can you include the legal + PR contacts in the bundle? Acme asked specifically about breach contact and how we handle encryption keys.

Sam (Legal): PR contact: comms@redwood.ai (cc legal@redwood.ai). Regarding keys: we do not hold customer KMS keys for hosted VPC customers — we support customer-managed KMS. For Private/on-prem we can integrate with customer HSMs. I'll add a short legal blurb on notification obligations and data handling.

Emma (SE): I'll add the encryption/keys language to the SOW: customer-managed KMS for VPC POC; BYOK supported in Private.

Mike (Solutions): For the SIG answers we should include link to SOC2 (redacted) and the latest pentest summary. Ashley — can you confirm the pentest date so we include it?

Ashley (Security): Latest pen test completed 2025-11-03. I'll include the redacted report and call out annual tabletop exercises and IR metrics in the SIG answers. For the CAIQ control about incident response, we'll reference the playbook excerpt above.

Jess (Sales): Great. If Ashley drops the SIG/CAIQ draft and Sam the legal blurb, I'll send the package to the customer tomorrow AM. Pricing note: I'll propose 50% off the first month + 2 training seats.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: New doc uploaded to sales/poc: https://files.redwood/sales/poc/sig-caiq-draft-1782504321.pdf

Ashley (Security): Uploaded the SIG/CAIQ draft and IR excerpt here: https://files.redwood/sales/poc/sig-caiq-answers-1782504321.md :thumbsup:

Jess (Sales): Legend. Closing loop — send the bundle to Acme by 10:00 PT tomorrow. @Emma can you prep the SOW? @Mike confirm final pricing in the doc. Thanks everyone :rocket:
